lens4_audits.public_summary: Xu et al. (2012) establish active sensorimotor dendritic calcium spikes in barrel cortex while lacking abstract internal task-rule dendritic representations, SST-mediated rule gating, and rule-switching choice control. After Micah Blumberg 2022 immutable Git SAN anchors (a0090z, a0642z, a0310zNAPOT5), Zhang, Xu et al. (2025-06-04 bioRxiv v1) assemble all 9 joined dendritic rule-decision families simultaneously, with 7 of 9 confirmed in the 2026-10-15 Science public summary. Because the paywalled Science 2026 full body remains source-gated, conservative Lens 4 stays LSM-UNKNOWN (ceiling LSM-COMPONENT-SHIFT; quantitative-not-calibrated; access, copying, and intent unproven; 10 independent lineages credited).
